attendance-today.means: The share of students marked present today in sections whose register is submitted, plus how many sections still have no submitted register. Whether late counts as present follows your school's attendance rules.
attendance-today.source: It comes from today's whole-day attendance registers that teachers submit. The line shows the last 30 days; past days update overnight.
attendance-today.action: If sections are left, remind their teachers. The card's link opens Attendance, where you can see which registers are still open.

staff-today.means: How many active teachers and staff are marked present today, how many are on approved leave, and how many are absent without leave.
staff-today.source: It comes from today's staff attendance and from leave requests that were approved for today.
staff-today.action: If someone is absent without notice, check with them. View staff attendance opens Staff attendance.

collection-month.means: Money received this month so far, compared with the fee bills made for this month. Payments for older dues also count, so the share can pass 100%.
collection-month.source: It comes from payments recorded this month, minus reversed payments, and from this month's fee bills after discounts.
collection-month.action: If collection is behind last month, follow up on dues. View dues opens Student dues; with no bills yet, Generate fees opens the fee bill page.

mark-entry-progress.means: For the exam now taking marks, the share of section and subject mark sheets already submitted, class by class. The class furthest behind is named.
mark-entry-progress.source: It comes from the mark sheets teachers submit in Enter marks, for the latest exam that has started and is not yet processed.
mark-entry-progress.action: Remind the teachers of the class that is behind before the last day. The link opens Enter marks.

syllabus-progress.means: For each class this year, the share of syllabus topics marked done. When a class has a study plan, it also shows how far it should be by today.
syllabus-progress.source: It comes from syllabus topics teachers mark done, and from study plans and the class routine.
syllabus-progress.action: Talk to the teachers of classes that are behind. View syllabus opens Syllabus.

at-risk-students.means: Students who match at least 2 of 4 warning signs: absent days in a row, low attendance in 30 days, failed subjects, an old unpaid bill. Most signs first.
at-risk-students.source: It comes from attendance registers, the latest published exam results and unpaid fee bills. The list is rebuilt every night and after you change the limits.
at-risk-students.action: Talk to the student, the class teacher or the guardian. Change thresholds opens Settings, where the Dashboard section sets the 4 limits.

sms-balance.means: How many more SMS your school can send, and how many are held for messages being sent right now. Some schools are not metered.
sms-balance.source: It comes from your school's SMS credit, which goes down as messages are sent.
sms-balance.action: If the balance is low, top up before sending reminders. View sent messages opens the Message log, showing only SMS.

failed-messages.means: How many SMS could not be sent in the last 7 days, counting today.
failed-messages.source: It comes from the record of every SMS the school sent, such as fee reminders and alerts.
failed-messages.action: Check the phone numbers and the SMS balance, then send again. See which ones opens the Message log, showing the failed SMS of the same 7 days.

upcoming.means: The next holiday and up to five published events in the next 60 days.
upcoming.source: It comes from the events and holidays entered in the school calendar.
upcoming.action: To add or change an event, open Calendar from the card.

homework-submission-rate.means: The share of homework handed in, out of all homework due in the last 7 days, counting today. The class with the lowest share is named.
homework-submission-rate.source: It comes from homework that teachers set this academic year and the submissions recorded for each student.
homework-submission-rate.action: Ask the teachers of the lowest class why work is missing. See homework opens Homework.

recent-activity.means: The last 8 changes made in the system: who did it, what they did, and to which record.
recent-activity.source: It comes from the activity log, which records each add, change and delete.
recent-activity.action: If a change looks wrong, check it. Full activity log opens Activity log.

my-routine-today.means: Your periods today, in time order: class, subject and room. It also marks periods you are covering, cancelled periods and your own section.
my-routine-today.source: It comes from the class routine and any substitute teacher changes for today.
my-routine-today.action: Check your next period and room. Whole week's routine opens My routine.

my-pending-sections.means: How many of your sections still have no submitted attendance register today.
my-pending-sections.source: It comes from today's attendance registers for the sections you are allowed to mark.
my-pending-sections.action: Take attendance for each section left. The button opens that section's attendance register.

my-mark-deadlines.means: How many students still need marks from you in exams now taking marks, with the last day for each section and subject.
my-mark-deadlines.source: It comes from the sections and subjects assigned to you and the marks already entered for each student.
my-mark-deadlines.action: Enter the missing marks before the last day. The button opens that section's mark sheet; you can also open Enter marks.

homework-to-check.means: How many homework submissions are waiting for your check, and in how many homework they are.
homework-to-check.source: It comes from homework that students handed in for your sections and subjects.
homework-to-check.action: Check the work and give feedback. See submissions opens the Check work list of the first homework on the card.

class-teacher-streaks.means: Students of your own section who have been absent several school days in a row, up to the last register. The number of days comes from the Absent in a row (days) setting; it is 3 unless changed.
class-teacher-streaks.source: It comes from the whole-day attendance registers of the section where you are class teacher.
class-teacher-streaks.action: Call the guardian today. Tell guardian and the link both open your section page in My class.

my-leave-balance.means: How many leave days you have left this calendar year, out of your total quota, adding all leave types together.
my-leave-balance.source: It comes from the school's leave quotas and your approved leave requests, counting working days only.
my-leave-balance.action: To take leave, press Apply for leave; it opens the Leave page. If your leave is not set up, ask the office.

my-syllabus-progress.means: For each class and subject you teach, the share of syllabus topics marked done. With a study plan it also shows how far you should be.
my-syllabus-progress.source: It comes from the syllabus topics you mark done and from your study plans.
my-syllabus-progress.action: Mark finished topics as done to keep it correct. Open syllabus opens Syllabus.

collection-today.means: Money received today so far and the number of payments, split into cash, bKash, bank and other mobile. It compares with yesterday at the same time.
collection-today.source: It comes from payments recorded today, minus reversed payments.
collection-today.action: Check the cash in hand against this total at day end. Collections report opens Fee collection report.

collection-by-month.means: Money collected in each month of the current academic year, from its first month (the calendar year if no year is current). This month's figure is still running and is compared with the same days of last month.
collection-by-month.source: It comes from recorded payments, minus reversed payments.
collection-by-month.action: Look for months that fall behind. Open collections report opens Fee collection report.

dues-ageing.means: All unpaid fee money, split by how many days past the due date: 0–30, 31–60 and 60+ days. Bills not yet due count as 0–30.
dues-ageing.source: It comes from fee bills that are not fully paid, after payments and discounts.
dues-ageing.action: Follow up first on the oldest dues. See all dues opens Student dues.

dues-by-class.means: Unpaid fee money for each class, largest first, with how many students owe.
dues-by-class.source: It comes from fee bills that are not fully paid, grouped by each student's class.
dues-by-class.action: Start with the class that owes the most. The link opens Student dues for that class.

fee-generation-status.means: Whether fee bills for this month are made yet, how many bills were made, and when the next automatic billing runs.
fee-generation-status.source: It comes from the fee bill runs made this month and the automatic billing rules.
fee-generation-status.action: If bills are not made, press Generate fees. See bills opens Invoices.

reminders-pending.means: How many students have overdue fees past their reminder date but have not been sent a reminder since then.
reminders-pending.source: It comes from unpaid fee bills and the record of fee reminders already sent.
reminders-pending.action: Press Send reminders; it opens Fee reminders.

recent-payments.means: The last 5 payments received: student, class, amount, method and time. Payments that did not go through are shown but not added to the total.
recent-payments.source: It comes from payments recorded in the system, leaving out reversals.
recent-payments.action: Check that each payment is right. All payments opens Payments.

committee-enrollment.means: Total students this year and the change from last year, with up to 5 years shown.
committee-enrollment.source: It comes from the students enrolled in each academic year who are active or have graduated.
committee-enrollment.action: This card is for reading; it has no link. Ask the office if a year looks wrong.

committee-attendance.means: School-wide attendance for each month of this academic year, and this month's average, against the school's target (90% unless changed).
committee-attendance.source: It comes from submitted whole-day attendance registers. The last 7 days are live; older days update overnight.
committee-attendance.action: If attendance stays below the target, raise it at the meeting. The target is set in Settings, Dashboard section.

committee-finance.means: This month's collection against this month's bills, and money still unpaid on this academic year's bills, month by month.
committee-finance.source: It comes from fee bills and recorded payments.
committee-finance.action: This card is for reading; it has no link. Ask the accountant about high dues.

committee-pass-rate.means: The share of students who passed in the latest published exam, class by class, compared with the previous published exam.
committee-pass-rate.source: It comes from published exam results.
committee-pass-rate.action: This card is for reading; it has no link. Discuss the class with the lowest pass rate at the meeting.

seat-plan-status.means: Upcoming exams of this year that still need a seat plan for one or more sittings. An exam stays on the list until its first sitting day.
seat-plan-status.source: It comes from the exam schedule and the seat plans made for each sitting.
seat-plan-status.action: Make the missing seat plans before the exam. Open seat plans opens Seat plans.

results-state.means: How many of this year's exams have their results published, and how many are ready and waiting to be published. Each class counts as one exam.
results-state.source: It comes from each exam's status: draft, ready to publish or published.
results-state.action: Publish results that are ready. Open results opens Results.

admissions-today.means: New admission applications that came in today, how many in all are waiting for review, and the latest 5.
admissions-today.source: It comes from the admission applications your school has received.
admissions-today.action: Review the waiting applications. Open applicants opens Admission applicants.

guardians-incomplete.means: How many guardian records are incomplete. A record is incomplete with no name, no relationship, or no phone number at all.
guardians-incomplete.source: It comes from the guardian details entered for students.
guardians-incomplete.action: Fill in the missing details so messages reach the guardian. See who opens Guardians.

students-added-today.means: How many students were added to the system today.
students-added-today.source: It comes from student records created today, one at a time or by import.
students-added-today.action: Check the new records are complete. Open students opens Students.

approvals-pending.means: How many applications, such as leave, admission or fee waiver requests, are waiting for your decision, and when the oldest was sent.
approvals-pending.source: It comes from applications staff, guardians or students sent that are in your inbox.
approvals-pending.action: Decide the oldest first. Open the inbox opens Applications.

print-queue.means: How many documents are still waiting to be printed: admit cards for upcoming exams with a published seat plan, and student ID cards.
print-queue.source: It comes from active students and the record of what was already printed. A failed or cancelled print still counts as waiting.
print-queue.action: Print the waiting cards. Open the print queue opens Print & documents.

setup-checklist.means: The steps left to set up your school, such as school profile, classes, sections, students, staff and fees. It disappears when all are done or hidden.
setup-checklist.source: It comes from what your school has already entered in the system.
setup-checklist.action: Press a step to finish it, or press Hide to remove the card.

syllabus-vs-plan.means: For each class with a study plan, how much is taught against how much should be taught by today, and how many past lessons nobody updated.
syllabus-vs-plan.source: It comes from study plans, the class routine and the lesson updates teachers make.
syllabus-vs-plan.action: Talk to the teachers of classes behind. The link opens Syllabus on the Study plans tab.

my-lessons-to-mark.means: Your past routine periods in a study plan that you have not yet marked as taught or not taught. Today does not count.
my-lessons-to-mark.source: It comes from your study plans, the class routine and periods you covered for others.
my-lessons-to-mark.action: Mark each lesson's status. Mark lessons opens My routine.
